text: {"score":3,"justification":"The core numbers match the card (24.4% vs 1.9% expected, 12.16 risk-adjusted score, z 3.78, 78% low-complexity, 14/14 documented 99215s at high MDM, 7 of 26 with no lab on the claim). The unmatched 23% is a legitimate ratio (7/26 = 26.9%, so it is not 23%). The summary has real weaknesses: the rationale repeats itself, one claim is wrong, the cited examples do not fit the point, and the next steps are generic.","problems":["The '23%' figure for 7 of 26 is wrong: 7/26 is about 27%.
